name: 6sense
description_en:
6sense is a product in the Marketing analytics category. Its directory profile covers Spend Analysis, Cross Device Tracking, BI Tools Integration, Campaign Performance Tracking, Attribution, AI-Powered Insights, Predictive Analytics, KPI Monitoring.

Additional listed capabilities include Data Source, Conversion Tracking, Segmentation, Interactive Dashboard, Collaboration. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: use historical information to estimate future outcomes; record defined completion events in a user journey. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
